lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Digital Life, Purchases, and Consumer Skills
lessonRef.title: Explicit model: subscriptions and in-app purchases

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic subscriptions and in-app purchases task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner finds one subscription or in-app purchases screen already present on a device in the household, such as a streaming app, a game, or cloud storage, and reads through its details to answer specific questions about cost and cancellation, without creating any new subscription.
safetyNotes: The learner only opens subscription or account settings on a device or account they are already permitted to use, and does not change, cancel, or agree to anything during this task.

simulationAlternative.description: If no subscription or in-app purchases screen is available in the household, the learner instead reviews a provided sample subscription screen showing a monthly cost, billing cycle, and cancellation steps, and answers the same questions using that sample.

materials: learner-local: paper or a notes app

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Explain one specific step you would take before agreeing to any future subscription, based on what you learned about how this one bills and cancels.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Cost and cancellation identification: The exact cost, billing frequency, and cancellation steps are all correctly found and recorded. | Recurring cost reasoning: A correct yearly total is calculated and compared to a specific one-time-cost item. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner compare two different subscriptions (real or from the provided samples) and rank them by true yearly cost rather than by their advertised weekly or monthly price.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic subscriptions and in-app purchases task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or a notes app
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner finds one subscription or in-app purchases screen already present on a device in the household, such as a streaming app, a game, or cloud storage, and reads through its details to answer specific questions about cost and cancellation, without creating any new subscription.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact subscriptions and in-app purchases decision or action.
Model move 2: Think of one subscription, or one game or app with in-app purchases, already active on a device you use or a household device.
Model move 3: Open that app's account or subscription settings and read the actual details, without changing or canceling anything yet.

Model check: Cost and cancellation identification: The exact cost, billing frequency, and cancellation steps are all correctly found and recorded. | Recurring cost reasoning: A correct yearly total is calculated and compared to a specific one-time-cost item.

resources.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for subscriptions and in-app purchases.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner finds one subscription or in-app purchases screen already present on a device in the household, such as a streaming app, a game, or cloud storage, and reads through its details to answer specific questions about cost and cancellation, without creating any new subscription.
Coach direction: Think of one subscription, or one game or app with in-app purchases, already active on a device you use or a household device.
Learner prompt: Name the app or service and guess what you think it costs before checking the actual screen.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Open that app's account or subscription settings and read the actual details, without changing or canceling anything yet.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I found the exact cost and how often it charges (weekly, monthly, or yearly).
Response 2 (t2-p2): I found the specific steps listed for canceling it, without actually canceling it.

Equal-access rule: If no subscription or in-app purchases screen is available in the household, the learner instead reviews a provided sample subscription screen showing a monthly cost, billing cycle, and cancellation steps, and answers the same questions using that sample.

resources.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Explain one specific step you would take before agreeing to any future subscription, based on what you learned about how this one bills and cancels.

Success checks: Cost and cancellation identification: The exact cost, billing frequency, and cancellation steps are all correctly found and recorded. | Recurring cost reasoning: A correct yearly total is calculated and compared to a specific one-time-cost item.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional subscriptions and in-app purchases condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Cost and cancellation identification: The exact cost, billing frequency, and cancellation steps are all correctly found and recorded. | Recurring cost reasoning: A correct yearly total is calculated and compared to a specific one-time-cost item..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Use only a safe, permitted setting and the materials already available to you.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
Open that app's account or subscription settings and read the actual details, without changing or canceling anything yet.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record and the completed application responses.

simulationRoute.title: subscriptions and in-app purchases — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: If no subscription or in-app purchases screen is available in the household, the learner instead reviews a provided sample subscription screen showing a monthly cost, billing cycle, and cancellation steps, and answers the same questions using that sample.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: Explain one specific step you would take before agreeing to any future subscription, based on what you learned about how this one bills and cancels.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Cost and cancellation identification: The exact cost, billing frequency, and cancellation steps are all correctly found and recorded. | Recurring cost reasoning: A correct yearly total is calculated and compared to a specific one-time-cost item.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g7-u05-l02-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
